title.narrative: Conservation of the 19th-Century Finca Viga, the American Writer Ernest Hemingway's House in Havana

description.narrative: Ernest Hemingway's home in Havana, known as Finca Viga, is an important cultural site that attracts thousands of visitors and scholars annually. The project aims to restore and preserve up to six critically damaged windows to protect the home and its valuable collection from environmental threats. Activities include assessing the current condition of the windows, fabricating hurricane-resistant replacements, and installing them with the help of trained specialists.
